Name: CP - Mushroom Farmhouse
Author: spotteddotted
Description:
Replaces the farmhouse with a cute mushroom!
Includes all three house upgrades and seasonal variations!

<3

[b]Configuration
[/b]Currently comes with two different styles of the stem and cap of the mushroom, which can be set independently of each other. It also allows you to set if the colour of the mushrooms changes with the seasons, or stays in the Fall colour!

House options:
Cute, Detailed

Cap options: 
Cute, Detailed

Colour options:
Seasonal, Fall

<3

Let me know if you have any mod suggestions or there are any mistakes
You can also [url=https://ko-fi.com/dotsanddashes]support[/url] me!!
